name: Old Fashioned
instructions: Stir whiskey, bitters and sugar syrup with ice in a rocks glass. Strain over fresh ice and garnish with an orange peel.

name: Margarita
instructions: Rim a coupe glass with salt. Shake tequila, lime juice and triple sec with ice, then strain into the glass.

name: Cosmopolitan
instructions: Shake vodka, triple sec, cranberry juice and lime juice with ice. Strain into a martini glass and garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Gin and Tonic
instructions: Fill a highball glass with ice, pour over the gin and top with chilled tonic water. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Mojito
instructions: Lightly press the mint leaves with the sugar syrup, add rum and lime juice, fill with crushed ice, then top with soda water and stir once.

name: Pina Colada
instructions: Blend rum, pineapple juice and coconut cream with crushed ice until smooth. Pour into a hurricane glass and garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry.

name: Whiskey Sour
instructions: Shake whiskey, lemon juice and simple syrup with ice. Strain over fresh ice and garnish with a lemon wheel.

name: Caipirinha
instructions: Muddle the lime wedges with the sugar in a rocks glass, fill with crushed ice, add the cachaça and stir briefly.

name: Dark 'N' Stormy
instructions: Build rum and ginger beer over ice in a highball glass, add the lime juice and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Sidecar
instructions: Shake cognac, Cointreau and lemon juice with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and rim with sugar.

name: Moscow Mule
instructions: Build vodka and ginger beer over ice in a copper mug, add the lime juice and stir. Garnish with a lime wedge and a mint sprig.

name: Daiquiri
instructions: Shake rum, lime juice and simple syrup hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe.

name: Sazerac
instructions: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe and discard the excess. Stir whiskey, bitters and sugar with ice, strain over fresh ice and garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Pimm's Cup
instructions: Build Pimm's No. 1 and lemonade over ice in a tall glass. Garnish with cucumber slices and a mint sprig.

name: Espresso Martini
instructions: Shake vodka, espresso, Kahlúa and sugar syrup hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with coffee beans.

name: French 75
instructions: Shake gin, lemon juice and sugar syrup with ice, strain into a flute, then top with chilled champagne. Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Mai Tai
instructions: Shake rum, orange curaçao, lime juice and orgeat syrup with ice. Pour unstrained into a rocks glass and garnish with a mint sprig and a cherry.

name: Negroni
instructions: Stir gin, Campari and sweet vermouth with ice for about 20 seconds. Strain over a large ice cube and garnish with an orange twist.

name: Cuba Libre
instructions: Squeeze lime juice into a highball glass, add the rum, fill with ice and top with Coca-Cola. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Bee's Knees
instructions: Shake gin, honey syrup and lemon juice with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and garnish with a lemon wheel.
